note: Single source for the Grade 4 game list: build-config.cjs writes worksheet-generator/grade4/config.js from it and integration.cjs lists the games on the unit pages.

games.title: Treasure Quest
games.intro: Follow the treasure map. Each correct answer moves you to the next stop and adds a gem to your chest.
games.description: Follow the treasure map stop by stop and collect gems. Play alone or as a class.

games.title: Space Rescue
games.intro: Astronauts are waiting at each stop. Answer two questions correctly to fly to the next stop and rescue them.
games.description: Fly from planet to planet and rescue astronauts. No timer: every flight needs two correct answers.

games.title: Puzzle Island
games.intro: Sail from island to island. Answer two questions correctly on each island to earn its puzzle piece and sail on.
games.description: Sail across six islands, earning a puzzle piece on each one.

games.title: Castle Conquest
games.intro: Every correct answer adds a part to your castle: walls, towers, a gate and flags. Build all 12 parts to conquer the castle!
games.description: Build a castle one part at a time with correct answers.

games.title: Math Detective
games.intro: A trophy is missing! Each correct answer uncovers one clue tile. Uncover all 12 clues to solve the case.
games.description: Uncover clue tiles to reveal a hidden picture and solve the mystery.

games.title: Monster Match
games.intro: Flip two cards. Work out each monster's problem and match it to its answer star. Match all the pairs to win.
games.description: Flip cards and match each problem to its answer, alone or with a partner.

games.title: Rocket Race
games.intro: Teams take turns. A correct answer moves your rocket one space. The first team to the finish line wins!
games.description: Two to four teams race; a correct answer moves the team rocket one space.

games.title: Math Soccer
games.intro: A correct answer kicks the ball toward the other goal and keeps the ball. A miss is a turnover. Score 3 goals to win!
games.description: Two teams kick the ball toward the goal with correct answers.

games.title: Four in a Row
games.intro: Answer correctly to drop a disc in a column. Get four in a row to win!
games.description: Two teams answer to earn discs. Four in a row wins.

games.title: Fraction Match-Up
games.intro: Look at each fraction model and choose the matching fraction. Watch for equivalent fractions!
games.description: Match fraction models to fractions, including equivalent fractions and simplest form. Models are drawn exactly from the chosen numbers.

games.title: Array Attack
games.intro: Look at each array of dots. Choose the product, the equation or the split that matches it.
games.description: Read multiplication arrays and area-model splits: products, equations, division and the distributive property. Arrays are drawn exactly from the chosen numbers.
